answers.Q1: Every ability (Recommended): Traits, techniques, signatures, school arts, bloodline faculties all get one name and one paragraph
answers.Q2: As long as it needs: no cap
answers.Q3: Full LitRPG figures: EU cost, % of reserve, Grade, m/s, joules, all inline in the paragraph
answers.Q4: Only what fits: belief, cost, limit and counter always; offices, Lattice property and nucleation only when they read naturally
answers.Q5: Left implied: no belief line; the effect implies it, the Shear Break counter still exists in the design
answers.Q6: The paragraph is the page (Recommended): name, Reflection or kind, the paragraph, nothing else
answers.Q7: One word, + gloss by culture: one simple name; characters with a naming register add a short gloss
answers.Q8: Convert when touched (Recommended): an entry is rewritten to the paragraph shape when next edited or used
